title: Zesty Grassy Ethiopian Teff Flatbread
description: A traditional Ethiopian flatbread made with teff flour and infused with the warmth of red chilli flakes, perfect for a solo dinner, this dish is ayurvedic tamasic friendly and features a long fermentation dough process.
instructions: Combine teff flour, red chilli flakes, yeast, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add water to the bowl and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment in a warm place for 24 hours.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or cast iron pan over medium heat.
Divide the fermented dough into 4 equal portions and roll each portion into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Cook the flatbread for 1-2 minutes on each side, until it is lightly browned and crispy.
Brush the flatbreads with ghee or vegan oil and sprinkle with chopped cilantro and lemon juice.
